name: Kierac the Destroyer

facts.text: Level 69, 30,000 health. He shields himself with Shield of Pain (a bladeturn) and takes 20% less from melee; when he dies the Master of Pain appears.
He cannot be hurt beyond his tether of 1,800.

story: Kierac was a prisoner of Tur Suil once, a Fomorian deserter or a captured champion of some other race; nobody remembers which, least of all Kierac. The Master of Pain made him into a weapon. He gave him a skin of pain that turns the first blow of every fight, and he gave him a rage that has outlasted his memory. And then, the Sylvan say, the Master of Pain climbed inside him to rest, as a worm rests in an apple. Kierac guards the torturer's hall, and he does not know what he is carrying. The raids that kill him find out.
legend: His shield turns blows, so open with something cheap. He is only the first half: when he dies the Master of Pain comes out of him, fresh and stronger. Save mana and cooldowns for the second fight and do not rest between.

aggro: Destroy. Destroy. I remember that word.

phases.text: Something crawls out of Kierac's body!

atmosphere.realmFirstKill: Kierac is at peace. Something else is not.

briefing: kierac is phase one. when he dies the master of pain [spawns|comes out]. [save cooldowns|dont blow everything on kierac]

loremasterTopic.text: A prisoner made into a weapon by the Master of Pain, who now rides inside him. Kill Kierac, and the torturer climbs out.
